plan.title: Huế culture day: Đại Nội, Cung An Định, lăng Khải Định, chùa Thiên Mụ

activities.reason: Đại Nội is the core imperial-heritage site of Huế and matches the traveler's culture priority; winter schedule 07:00-17:30 applies in December.
Cung An Định is an Nguyễn-dynasty palace in the city centre, adding culture content with short in-town movement; winter hours 07:00-17:00.
Quán hến Hoa Đông is a local Huế dish stop with reported daily hours 07:00-22:00, a practical lunch break between the citadel area and the tombs.
lăng Khải Định is a Nguyen-dynasty royal tomb with strong architecture and culture interest match; winter hours 07:00-17:30 close before 15:00, so the visit is placed in the afternoon window.
Chùa Thiên Mụ is a landmark pagoda on the Hương river side, adding culture content; the dataset reports it as open 24/7 (provisional dataset value, not independently verified).
Chè Cầm is a well-known Huế sweet-soup stop that opens at 16:00, fitting the late-afternoon gap after the pagoda.
Cơm niêu chạn serves a multi-dish Huế-style rice meal with reported daily hours 08:00-22:00, giving a sit-down dinner inside the group budget.

missingData: durationMin is null for every attraction and dining place in the dataset, so visit and meal lengths used in the schedule are planning assumptions, not dataset values.

Travel times and distances: every travelMatrix entry for the used pairs is null, and several pairs (attraction-to-dining, dining-to-attraction) are absent, so all travelLegs durationMin and distanceKm are null.
Travel time from the Huế departure point to the first stop (Đại Nội) is not in the dataset.
Cung An Định admission price is reported inconsistently in the dataset (25,000 VND in one source vs 50,000 VND in another, flag source_conflict); current price needs confirmation before booking.
Chùa Thiên Mụ opening hours are reported by the dataset as 24/7 (dataset value only, not independently verified), and its address is listed as unverified.
No verified duration or ticket-sales cut-off confirmation for lăng Khải Định and Đại Nội beyond the reported winter window 07:00-17:30.
Quán hến Hoa Đông price scope and average price are unverified; the 17,500 VND figure is an estimated average per person in the dataset.

Cơm niêu chạn price scope is unspecified in the dataset and its per-person range is estimated (250,000-300,000 VND published, different source gives 100,000-200,000 VND); the 275,000 VND value is a dataset estimate.
Chè Cầm price is a 'from' price (from 15,000 VND per cup) and varies by type; no fixed price confirmed.
Availability of seasonal dishes on 2026-12-01 (including bún giấm nuốc) is unknown.
No data on advance booking requirements, closures for restoration, or holiday adjustments on 2026-12-01.
assumptions: 2026-12-01 falls in the dataset's winter season (10-16 to 03-15), so Đại Nội and lăng Khải Định use the 07:00-17:30 window and Cung An Định uses 07:00-17:00.
Because durationMin is null for all dataset places, each activity's start/end time is a scheduling assumption chosen to fit the reported opening hours; the server should re-check feasibility.
Costs shown are the dataset's per-person prices for one adult ticket or one serving, not multiplied by the 2 travelers or by meal counts; the 3,000,000 VND group budget check is left to the server.
Sightseeing places were selected for the traveler's culture interest; dining places were chosen for reported opening hours that fit the day and available price data.
Land transport by car/taxi is assumed between stops in Huế; no travel-time verification is claimed.
Opening hours marked UNVERIFIED/REPORTED in the dataset are provisional and may differ from actual operating hours on the travel date.
